# Corphik

> IT support, repairs, and custom computer services by Aleš Pospíšil.

For home users, students, and small businesses. In person in Prague and nearby areas (Czechia), and remote support across Spain and the rest of Europe. Languages: Czech, English, Spanish. Prices are listed in CZK; "+" indicates the starting price.

CS: IT podpora pro domácnosti, studenty a malé firmy v Praze a okolí, na dálku po Evropě.
ES: Soporte informático para particulares, estudiantes y pequeñas empresas en Praga y a distancia en Europa.

## Services / Služby / Servicios

- Custom PC builds / Sestavení PC na míru / PC a medida
  1,500 CZK+.
  Custom-built computers tailored to your budget and use case (gaming, office work, study, design, etc.).
  Parts are ordered after a deposit is paid.
  The PC is built, tested, and delivered free of charge in Prague and nearby areas.

- Windows & Linux installation / Instalace / Instalación
  700 CZK+.
  Clean installation, driver setup, updates, software configuration, and basic system setup.
  Windows licence is not included.
  In person service.

- PC upgrades & performance tuning / Upgrade a zrychlení / Mejora
  500 CZK+.
  SSD installation, RAM upgrades, GPU replacement, cleaning, thermal paste renewal, and general performance improvements.
  Parts are extra.
  In person service.

- Diagnostics & repairs / Diagnostika a opravy / Diagnóstico y reparación
  400 CZK+.
  For computers that won’t start, crash, run slowly, make unusual noises, or show other problems.
  Some issues can be diagnosed remotely.
  The diagnostic fee is deducted from the final repair cost when the repair goes ahead.

- Domain & DNS setup / Nastavení domény a DNS / Configuración de dominio y DNS
  800 CZK+.
  DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT incl. SPF, DKIM, DMARC), connecting a domain to a website and email.
  Remote only.

- Website redesign / Redesign webu / Rediseño web
  3,499 CZK+.
  Modern website design, responsive/mobile-friendly layout, faster loading, and basic security improvements.
  Remote service.

- Remote help / Vzdálená pomoc / Ayuda a distancia
  400 CZK/hour, billed in 15-minute increments.
  Troubleshooting, software installation, settings changes, general IT support, and advice.
  Remote only.

## How it works / Jak to probíhá / Cómo funciona

1. Send a request or describe the issue.
2. I reply to confirm the details, expected price, and suitable date.
3. The work is completed and explained clearly after the job.
